text:
sam: quick heads-up: planning to start a staged rollout of routing.runtime.staged_safety_level tonight. target initial cohort 10%. want quick console 'Preview + validate' before apply. cc @jen @kevin
jen: 👍 please include expected quota & cost delta. product wants one-click preflight that returns a validation report.
sam: draft preview link: /console/configs/runtime/staged-safety-level?preview=true
kevin: telemetry ask: trace-level mapping + token-level cost breakdown. add temp alert if p95 > 250ms for 5m.
tia: propose sample_rate=0.5 for canary cohort. dashboard panels: p50/p95 latency, error-rate, quota-consumption, cost-per-token, and a new metric config.rollout.latency.delta.
mike: please add dry_run mode that simulates routing decisions and emits metrics without changing weights. run synthetic load for 15m against dry-run to validate.
sam: backend contract: POST /api/configs/apply?dry_run=true with payload; respond with a validation report (diffs, estimated qps, sampling hints). curl example: `curl -X POST /api/configs/apply?dry_run=true -d @payload.json -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"`
ops-bot: deploybot: canary cluster redeploy queued (job x123). ETA ~12m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
kevin: add a temporary SLO for canary: p95 target 200ms, TTL 1h. if violated, auto-pause rollout and tag owners.
tia: +1. also log trace_id -> config_version so we can find offending traces quickly and rollback.
jen: I'll run the synthetic job and watch those dashboards. can we show a concise "preflight report" UI: quota delta, cost estimate, top affected customers, and risk level? product wants that.
mike: i'll add playbook snippet to the console: how to pause, pin fallback routes, and force rollback. example rollback command: `curl -X POST /api/configs/apply -d '{"key":"routing.runtime.staged_safety_level","value":0.0}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"`
sam: rollout plan: start 23:30 PT tonight. windows: 10% -> 30% -> 60% -> 100% with 30m observation. i'll post updates in #eng-platform and open a short postmortem if needed.
jen: thanks — ping if you want me to kill the synthetic or force rollback.
mike: also recommend adding a light-weight canary cookie/header so we can trace requests end-to-end back to routing decision. small console change: show example header and a lookup page to trace a request id to a config version.
sam: nice. i'll include that in preview. pushing preview now, will trigger dry-run and synthetic soon. :rocket:
